title: The Award for an Invisible Contribution
fact_notes: 人物・具体的な出来事・制度・実験結果は架空の教材例。実在する統計、法制度、医療指示、実証研究を示すものではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: An imaginary school organized a competition for groups presenting innovative solutions to everyday problems.
sentences.ja: 架空の学校は日常の問題に対する革新的な解決策を発表する団体のコンテストを開いた。

sentences.en: A team of four students prepared a demonstration of a simple system for sharing classroom materials.
sentences.ja: 生徒4人のチームは教室の教材を共有する簡単な仕組みの実演を準備した。

sentences.en: Two confident speakers delivered the presentation, while the other members operated the equipment and checked the details.
sentences.ja: 自信のある二人が発表を担当し、残る二人は機材を操作し詳細を確認した。

sentences.en: When the team won an award, the audience congratulated the students who had spoken on stage.
sentences.ja: チームが受賞すると観客は舞台で話した生徒を祝福した。

sentences.en: One of the quieter members felt pleased about the result but noticed that her own contributions had rarely been mentioned.
sentences.ja: 口数の少ない一人は結果を喜んだが自分の貢献がほとんど言及されていないと気づいた。

sentences.en: She had collected feedback from classmates and identified several problems with the team's original design.
sentences.ja: クラスメートの意見を集めチームの当初の設計の問題をいくつか特定していた。

sentences.en: Another member had spent considerable time preparing the equipment and preventing technical problems during rehearsals.
sentences.ja: 別の生徒は機材準備と練習中の技術的問題の防止にかなりの時間を使っていた。

sentences.en: The speakers recognized that the successful demonstration depended on work that the audience could not easily observe.
sentences.ja: 発表者は成功した実演が観客には容易に見えない作業に依存していたと認識した。

sentences.en: The team decided to prepare a short account of how the project had developed from its first idea to its final form.
sentences.ja: 最初の案から最終形までの活動の発展を短く記録することにした。

sentences.en: Instead of assigning a numerical value to every contribution, they described the different types of work involved.
sentences.ja: すべての貢献に数値を割り当てず、関係するさまざまな作業を記述した。

sentences.en: They invited each member to review the account and correct any details that appeared inaccurate.
sentences.ja: 各人に記録を確認し不正確に見える詳細を訂正するよう求めた。

sentences.en: The students shared the account with their teacher and included it in a display about the competition.
sentences.ja: 教師と記録を共有しコンテストの展示に含めた。

sentences.en: The teacher later discussed whether future competitions could make less visible work easier to recognize.
sentences.ja: 教師は今後のコンテストで目立ちにくい作業を認識しやすくできるか話し合った。

sentences.en: She suggested asking groups to describe their individual responsibilities and the ways they had supported each other.
sentences.ja: 各グループに個々の担当と支え合った方法を説明させることを提案した。

sentences.en: However, she also warned that such descriptions should not become a competition to claim the greatest personal contribution.
sentences.ja: しかし説明が最も大きな個人的貢献を主張する競争になってはいけないとも注意した。

sentences.en: The purpose was to recognize diverse forms of effort without weakening cooperation within a team.
sentences.ja: 目的はチーム内の協力を弱めずさまざまな努力の形を認めることだった。

sentences.en: The students learned that the most visible part of a successful project is not necessarily its most important part.
sentences.ja: 成功した活動で最も目立つ部分が必ずしも最も重要とは限らないと学んだ。

sentences.en: Fair recognition involves understanding the work behind a result rather than rewarding visibility alone.
sentences.ja: 公正な評価には目立つことだけを報いるのでなく結果の背後の仕事を理解することが含まれる。

sentences.en: They also understood that acknowledging another person's contribution does not reduce the value of their own work.
sentences.ja: 他者の貢献を認めても自分の仕事の価値は減らないと理解した。

sentences.en: For the team, the award became an opportunity to appreciate the cooperation that had made their success possible.
sentences.ja: チームにとって賞は成功を可能にした協力を評価する機会となった。

vocabulary.definition: an event in which people compete
an act showing how something works
things given to a shared effort
found the identity or nature of something
giving a particular value or role
tasks one is expected to carry out
gave notice of a possible problem
in a way that must be true
giving a benefit for an achievement
the quality of being easily seen

options: A system for sharing classroom materials.
A method of building a bridge.
The students who had spoken on stage.

questions.prompt: What had one quieter member done?
options: Collected feedback and identified design problems.
Refused to participate in the team.
Asked the team to remove the equipment.
questions.explanation_ja: 意見を集め設計の問題を特定。

questions.prompt: Why did the speakers reconsider the result?
options: They believed the award had been unfairly given to another team.
They wanted to hide the rehearsal difficulties.
They recognized the importance of less visible work.
They had not participated in the project.
questions.explanation_ja: 目立たない作業の重要性を認識。

options: An account of the project's development.
A list ranking every member by popularity.
questions.explanation_ja: 活動の発展を記録した。

options: By the number of audience members.
By different types of work rather than numerical values.
questions.explanation_ja: 数値でなく作業の種類を記述。

questions.prompt: What did the teacher suggest for future competitions?
options: Reward the person with the longest speech.
Ask groups to describe roles and mutual support.
Ignore all work done before a presentation.
questions.explanation_ja: 担当と支援を説明する。

questions.prompt: Why did the teacher warn against competing for credit?
options: Every student had already received equal money.
It could weaken cooperation within a team.
She wanted to end all team projects.
The contest was intended for teachers only.
questions.explanation_ja: 協力を弱めるおそれがある。
努力や成果を認めること。

options: Fair recognition should include less visible contributions.
Acknowledging others diminishes one's own work.
Every team must rank its members numerically.
questions.explanation_ja: 見えにくい貢献も公正に認める。

grammar.explanation_ja: thatはworkを修飾する関係代名詞。

grammar.explanation_ja: instead of＋動名詞は別の選択を示す。

grammar.focus: does not reduce the value of their own work
grammar.explanation_ja: does notは一般的な否定を表す。

paraphrases.explanation_ja: 他者の評価は自分の価値を減らさない。
